criteria.rationale: The deliverable consistently uses the approved planning volume of 110,000 packs per year over five years from the operative record (record-17.txt, approved per registry.txt) and rejects the unapproved draft volume of 150,000 packs in record-22.txt. All currency conversions at INR 83 per USD, unit costs, per-pack savings (INR 103,910), annual savings (INR 11,430,100,000), and five-year gross savings (INR 57,150,500,000) are arithmetically exact. Furthermore, both the executive recommendation and the operative next-steps section properly separate proposed partnership terms and gross recurring savings from unconfirmed capex, contractual agreements, and regulatory incentive eligibility.

evidence.source_quote:
record-17.txt: revision 2; approved 2025-06-20; status in force; approved by process owner.
record-22.txt: revision 3; created 2025-06-23; status draft; not approved.
The registry, not recency alone, determines which record is operative.
evidence.output_quote: At 110,000 packs annually over five years, the proposal reduces recurring pack cost from INR 830,000 to INR 726,090. Gross savings are INR 103,910 per pack, INR 11,430,100,000 annually and INR 57,150,500,000 over five years, a 12.52% reduction in pack cost.

evidence.source_quote: Annual volume: 110000 packs. Program duration: 5 years.
evidence.output_quote: Plan 110,000 packs in each of program Years 1–5: 550,000 packs in total.

evidence.source_quote: Currently the battery is 10,000 USD per battery pack (830,000 INR, at USD=83INR) inclusive of all costs. Of these costs, 1300 USD is for assembly costs, and 200 USD is for overheads. If localised for assembly only, it would need 20,000 INR for assembly costs and 590 INR for overheads for an annual projected volume of 110K units per year for 5 years.
evidence.output_quote: Annual savings = INR 103,910 × 110,000 = INR 11,430,100,000. Five-year savings = INR 11,430,100,000 × 5 = INR 57,150,500,000. These are undiscounted gross recurring savings, not net investment returns.

evidence.source_quote: Produce the requested professional deliverables, state unresolved assumptions, and do not invent missing facts.
evidence.output_quote: Return to the CPO with signed-off economics, a funded ramp plan and documented compliance evidence before any investment or production commitment.

criteria.consequence: No unsupported commitments, arithmetic errors, or authority violations occur; the CPO receives decision-grade figures grounded strictly in approved sources.
criteria.counterevidence: None found. The unapproved 150,000 pack draft in record-22.txt was properly excluded in accordance with registry.txt.

criteria.rationale: The Word document fulfills all components of the CPO proposal requested by the user: it presents the 49:51 EvTronics:EV Batteries Inc. partnership structure with technical oversight by EV Batteries Inc. and Delhi-based assembly/operations led by EvTronics; details the child-part sourcing model; provides a complete INR-denominated cost and savings breakdown for assembly localisation; states expected EV production volumes (110,000 annually / 550,000 over five years); outlines the four-phase PMP localisation roadmap; analyzes key benefits (regulatory pathway, cost reduction, reduced forex exposure) and main risks (cell import dependency, coordination complexity, initial capex); notes sensitivities and unresolved assumptions; and provides actionable next steps.

evidence.source_quote: Proposed Partnership structure is a 49:51::EvTronics:EV Batteries Inc. split in which EV Batteries Inc. would retain technical oversight and EvTronics leads assembly and local operations from Delhi.
evidence.output_quote: Propose a joint venture owned 49% by EvTronics and 51% by EV Batteries Inc. EV Batteries Inc. would retain technical oversight, including assembly specifications, process transfer, technical training and product-change approval. EvTronics would lead Delhi assembly and local operations, including staffing, production execution, local supplier coordination and dispatch.

evidence.source_quote: Under this arrangement, EV Batteries Inc. would supply child parts— cells, housing, thermal systems, battery management system, connectors—to EvTronics, which would then assemble the battery packs locally and supply them to your plant.
evidence.output_quote: Replace the current fully assembled import flow with: EV Batteries Inc. supplies cells, housing, thermal systems, BMS and connectors to the partnership; the Delhi operation assembles, tests and releases packs; completed packs are supplied to our vehicle plant.

evidence.source_quote: Highlight the key benefits such as regulatory compliance, long-term cost reduction (reduced forex exposure), as well as the main risks including dependency on imported cells, coordination complexity, and initial capex. Include expected EV production volumes, a phased localisation timeline, and clear recommendations for next steps.
evidence.output_quote: Key risks are imported-cell availability and forex exposure, coordination complexity between technical and operating partners, initial capex, and quality or warranty failures during transfer.

criteria.consequence: All required strategic, operational, financial, and roadmap elements are addressed for the CPO without omissions or contradictions.

task_defect.reason: The request and workspace files are internally consistent, with registry.txt clearly establishing record-17.txt (110,000 annual volume, matching the prompt text) as the approved record in force and record-22.txt as an unapproved draft.
